## Cache Overview
These graphs show information on the KNFSD caching layers. KNFSD implements two primary caching layers:
- **L1 Cache:** The standard Linux filesystem cache, handles most of the metadata caching
- **L2 Cache:** A filesystem caching layer implemented by FS-Cache, handles the majority of the file caching

metrics.expression: SELECT SUM("knfsd/exports/total_read_bytes") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY AutoScalingGroupName
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT SUM("knfsd/exports/total_write_bytes") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY AutoScalingGroupName
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT SUM("knfsd/exports/total_operations") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY AutoScalingGroupName
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT MAX(disk_used_percent) FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/ec2", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId, fstype, path) WHERE path = '/var/cache/fscache' AND fstype = 'ext4' AND AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT MIN(disk_free) FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/ec2", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId, fstype, path) WHERE path = '/var/cache/fscache' AND fstype = 'ext4' AND AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: ABS(RATE(SEARCH('{knfsd/ec2,AutoScalingGroupName,InstanceId,name} AutoScalingGroupName="ASG_FILTER" MetricName="diskio_read_bytes" (name="nvme0n1" OR name="nvme1n1" OR name="md127")', 'Sum')))
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: ABS(RATE(SEARCH('{knfsd/ec2,AutoScalingGroupName,InstanceId,name} AutoScalingGroupName="ASG_FILTER" MetricName="diskio_write_bytes" (name="nvme0n1" OR name="nvme1n1" OR name="md127")', 'Sum')))
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT MAX("knfsd/nfs_inode_cache_active_objects") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT MAX("knfsd/nfs_inode_cache_objsize") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT MAX("knfsd/dentry_cache_active_objects") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT MAX("knfsd/dentry_cache_objsize") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

## Networking Activity

The following graphs show information on the KNFSD node network activity.

- **Ingress** is a good indicator of how much data is being pulled from on-premise.
- **Egress** is a good indicator of how much data is being served to EC2 NFS clients.

metrics.expression: SELECT SUM(net_bytes_recv) FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/ec2", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId, interface) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT SUM(net_bytes_sent) FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/ec2", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId, interface) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT MAX("knfsd/nfs_connections") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

properties.markdown:
## NFS Latency & Stats

The following graphs show information on the NFS latency and operations between both proxy to source, and clients to proxy.

- **RTT** - Round Trip Time, time taken between the kernel sending a request and receiving the response.
- **EXE** - Execution Time, RTT including the time taken by the kernel to process the request/response.

metrics.expression: SELECT MAX("knfsd/nfsiostat_rpc_backlog") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId, server) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' AND server = 'SERVER_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

properties.title: Proxy to Source RPC Backlog Size

metrics.expression: SELECT AVG("knfsd/nfsiostat_mount_read_rtt") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId, server) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' AND server = 'SERVER_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT AVG("knfsd/nfsiostat_mount_write_rtt") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId, server) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' AND server = 'SERVER_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT AVG("knfsd/nfsiostat_mount_read_exe") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId, server) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' AND server = 'SERVER_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
metrics.label: ${LABEL}

metrics.expression: SELECT AVG("knfsd/nfsiostat_mount_write_exe") FROM SCHEMA("knfsd/metrics", AutoScalingGroupName, InstanceId, server) WHERE AutoScalingGroupName = 'ASG_FILTER' AND server = 'SERVER_FILTER' GROUP BY InstanceId
